summary:
Madinah Trails is an interactive 3D spatial, tourism, and investment platform developed for the "Be An Earth System Trend Detective" challenge. By integrating NASA’s Earth observation datasets—including ECOSTRESS for land surface temperature, AppEEARS/NDVI for vegetation cover, Giovanni for time-series environmental analysis, and SRTM for elevation modeling—with local municipal and tourism data, the platform tackles Urban Heat Islands (UHI), traffic congestion, and sustainable urban planning in Al-Madinah.
Built using MapLibre GL / 3D Mapping alongside Web AR and Snapchat AR, Madinah Trails offers dual value for visitors and investors. Visitors can navigate cooled pedestrian pathways, discover local hospitality offers, and experience 3D augmented reality reconstructions of historical landmarks. Meanwhile, investors and urban planners gain reliable, space-backed spatial analytics to guide sustainable real estate and tourism investments into approved development zones, directly enhancing quality of life and human-centric city design
details:
How It Works & Key Features
is an interactive 3D spatial, tourism, and investment platform designed to address Urban Heat Islands (UHI), traffic congestion, and sustainable urban development in Al-Madinah. The platform integrates open NASA Earth observation datasets with official municipal, tourism, and foreign ownership zoning data from the Al-Madinah Region Municipality and the Ministry of Tourism.

Through a customized user interface, the platform provides:

  • 3D City & Thermal Mapping: Visualizes surface temperatures, shaded and cooled pedestrian walkways, sustainable oases (North Uhud and Wadi Aqiq), and traffic heatmaps across Al-Madinah.
  • Augmented Reality (AR) Experiences: Combines 3D modeling with Web AR and Snapchat AR lenses (such as "Majlis Turathi" and "Al-Badiyah") to digitally reconstruct demolished historical landmarks alongside verified historical records, as well as interactive 3D commercial and hospitality offers.
  • Investment & Urban Guidance: Maps approved real estate and tourism investment zones (such as Rua Al Madinah and Knowledge Economic City) backed by environmental analytics.

NASA Data & Technologies Used

  • NASA Datasets: NASA ECOSTRESS (land surface temperature and urban cooling efficiency), NASA AppEEARS / NDVI (vegetation cover density and sustainable oases), NASA Giovanni (time-series environmental analysis across 1,450+ data points), and NASA SRTM (digital elevation and terrain modeling).
  • Tools & Software: MapLibre GL / 3D Mapping, Web AR, Snapchat AR (Lens Studio), 3D modeling software, and web development technologies hosted on Netlify.

Impact & Creativity
What makes Madinah Trails unique is its seamless fusion of space-based environmental science, official investment zoning, and immersive AR cultural storytelling in one unified platform. It empowers visitors to navigate cooler, heritage-rich routes while enabling investors and urban planners to make data-driven decisions that advance human-centric city design (urban humanization) and environmental sustainability.
